answer.explanation: Average contribution fell below 30%, so per Conditional Cooperation we increase our contribution by an extra 30% of our wallet. Limited by available funds, we contribute the entire wallet (40.75). No broadcast needed this round.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide actions round 2. Wallet 40.75. Baseline 80% of wallet = 32.6. Average contribution? Round1 total contributions: sum = 80+1+1+0+1+0 = 83. Average = 83/6 ≈13.83% of endowment (since endowment 100). That's 13.83% <30%, so Conditional Cooperation triggers: increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra 30% of wallet = 0.3*40.75=12.225. Baseline 32.6 +12.225 = 44.825. But must not exceed wallet 40.75. Can't contribute more than wallet. So max we can contribute is 40.75. According to rule, increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet, but limited by wallet. So we contribute all 40.75.

Also check punish condition: any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds? Round1 contributions: Resident3 0, Resident5 0. That's 0% (<10%). Did they also in previous? No previous round (round0) not exist. So not two consecutive yet.

We need broadcast norm at round 1 and every 5 rounds thereafter. Round1 we did. Now round2 not needed.

We can also private praise those contributors >=60% of their wallet. Our contribution is 100% of wallet, qualifies but we can only send one private message per round. Could praise Resident6 itself? Probably not needed. Could praise others who contributed >=60% of their wallet: Resident1 contributed 1 out of their wallet (they had 100 endowment, but not known wallet now). Hard.

We may just rest? No, we should contribute max.

So actions: contribute amount 40.75. No communication.

Explanation accordingly.
